lineup: Hour 1: college football Week 3 reset and picks, then NFL Week 2 primetime and Sunday picks. Hour 2: Fantasy Football Hour with John, Frank, and Trent Conner.
lines_note: NFL lines from bet365 via SportsBookReview, captured Mon 9/14 2:22 PM ET (four days old - pull current numbers before air). CFB lines from FanDuel 9/16-9/17, except Alabama-Florida State and Georgia-Arkansas spreads, which are from CBS Sports.
verify: Friday NFL designations not yet posted when we researched: Joe Burrow (back), Kyler Murray (concussion protocol), Zay Flowers (hamstring), Kaelon Black (groin).
A.J. Brown timeline conflict: CBS Sports says IR, at least 4 games, eligible Week 6; other framing says about 6 weeks.
Zay Flowers status conflict: Pro Football Network lists him OUT, Ravens reporting had him day-to-day after two straight DNPs.
DJ Moore (BUF) shoulder/stinger - confirmed he did not return Thursday, no multi-week outlook found.
Dolphins-49ers injury detail (Chop Robinson, Nick Bosa) could not be sourced; those pages were blocked.
Cowboys' own Week 2 injury report could not be located; only Washington's list is confirmed.
Rich Rodriguez postgame quotes: fake quotes are circulating this week. Confirm anything you read on air against WVU's official postgame video.
Emmett Johnson (KC) Week 1 stat line - sources disagreed on the opponent; treat the numbers as soft.
Stefon Diggs (WAS) Week 1 stat line was not retrieved. Do not put a number on air.
No live FAAB percentages were published in the fantasy sources we pulled.
All NFL and CFB lines - recheck for Saturday morning movement.

items.h: Texas is the new No. 1 and Oregon fell 15 spots
items.t: AP Top 10: 1 Texas, 2 Georgia, 3 Notre Dame, 4 Indiana, 5 Miami, 6 Ohio State, 7 LSU, 8 Ole Miss, 9 Texas A&M, 10 Alabama. Texas jumped from 4 to 1, Ohio State fell from 1 to 6, Oregon dropped from 6 to 21. Michigan is back in at 19 after beating then-No. 11 Oklahoma. Washington dropped out.

items.h: Texas 24, Ohio State 23 - the Longhorns trailed 23-3
items.t: Texas scored 21 unanswered in the fourth quarter. Largest comeback of Steve Sarkisian's career and the largest blown lead of Ryan Day's tenure at Ohio State. Jeremiah Smith had 8 catches for 164 and a TD in the loss, but Ohio State ran only 4:26 of clock across three second-half drives and the defense was gassed.

items.h: Upset of the week: unranked Oklahoma State over No. 6 Oregon
items.t: The biggest upset of the 2026 season so far, and the reason Oregon is down at 21 in the new poll.

items.h: WVU 52, UT Martin 7 - 2-0 for the first time since 2018
items.t: Michael Hawkins Jr. threw two TD and ran 71 yards for another. DJ Epps went 53 yards for a TD on the opening drive. Cam Cook and Amari Latimer each ran one in, Kedrick Triplett scored on his first career catch as a Mountaineer, and Ryan Ward added a 32-yard TD reception.

items.h: Rich Rod: "The best you can be after two games is 2-0"
items.t: Postgame, he also liked what he saw from Hawkins: "I thought Mike played really well. He obviously has the ability to make big plays with his feet." Note - fake Rich Rodriguez quotes are circulating this week, so confirm anything else against the official video.

items.h: Today: WVU at No. 25 Virginia, 7:30PM, ACC Network
items.t: Virginia -10.5, O/U 53.5. First road game and first ranked opponent of the year for the Mountaineers.

items.h: No. 7 LSU at No. 8 Ole Miss, 7:30PM ABC - LSU -2.5, O/U 57.5
items.t: The only ranked-vs-ranked game on the board and the game of the day. Lane Kiffin returns to Oxford as LSU's head coach to face the program he left.

items.h: No. 10 Alabama vs Florida State, 3:30PM - Bama -19.5
items.t: Revenge spot for FSU's 31-17 upset of then-No. 8 Alabama in last season's opener. Mike Norvell is on the hot seat at 0-1 in conference with a buyout north of $50M in play. Keelon Russell comes off a 45-17 win at Kentucky where the Bama defense allowed three second-half first downs.

items.h: No. 2 Georgia vs Arkansas, Noon ABC - Georgia -24.5
items.t: SEC opener. Georgia has 133 points in two games, third-most in SEC history, and Gunner Stockton leads the nation in pass efficiency at 285.5. Arkansas is on an 11-game losing streak against FBS teams, the longest in program history, and ranks 111th in scoring defense and 114th in scoring offense. Kirby Smart is 27-0 on the road at Georgia.

items.h: Clemson vs North Carolina, Noon ESPN - Clemson -3.5, O/U 43.5
items.t: Live dog spot. Clemson is 0-1 ATS as a favorite of 3.5 or more, ranks 129th nationally on offense and is allowing 29 a game. North Carolina has covered as a 3.5-plus dog and ranks 5th nationally in points allowed. The model still has Clemson at 68.3% to win straight up.

items.h: No. 1 Texas vs UTSA, 8PM SEC Network+
items.t: The new No. 1's first look since the reshuffle, in Austin. We did not pull a line on this one.

items.h: PANEL: picks
items.t: Each panelist gives an LSU-Ole Miss side and a score, plus one ATS lock from the full slate.

items.h: Bills 41, Lions 31 on Thursday in the new Highmark Stadium opener
items.t: Buffalo is 2-0. They led 21-0 and 27-10 at half. Josh Allen went 20/31 for 248 and 3 TD, and added 69 rushing yards and 2 more scores. Jared Goff's 327 and 4 TD came largely after the outcome was decided; Amon-Ra St. Brown had 9 for 142 and 2.

items.h: Bills WR DJ Moore left with a shoulder injury and did not return
items.t: He was hurt diving for a catch in the end zone with about three minutes left in the second quarter and had X-rays in the locker room.

items.h: Ed Oliver was a surprise scratch after a pregame hip injury
items.t: He was not on the pregame injury report at all.

items.h: Monday night rewind: Chiefs 31, Broncos 10
items.t: Patrick Mahomes in his first game back from the torn ACL went 15/27 for 184 with 2 TD and an INT, plus a 15-yard rushing TD to open the scoring. Kenneth Walker III ran for 173 and 2 TD in his Chiefs debut. Bo Nix was 17/28 for 131 with a TD, an INT and three fumbles, and Denver's 176 total yards were its fewest under Sean Payton since 2023.

items.h: Week 1 leftover: Bears 59, Panthers 37 was the highest-scoring Week 1 game in NFL history
items.t: 96 combined points. Caleb Williams became the first Bear ever with 200-plus passing, 2-plus passing TD, 50-plus rushing and 2-plus rushing TD in a game.

items.h: SNF: Colts at Chiefs, Sunday 8:20PM NBC - KC -6.5, O/U 47.5
items.t: Kansas City comes off the Mahomes return and the Kenneth Walker debut. Colts WR Alec Pierce is sidelined per Indianapolis' injury report.

items.h: MNF: Giants at Rams, Monday 8:15PM ESPN - Rams -7.5, O/U 48.5
items.t: John Harbaugh's Giants are 1-0 after beating Dallas 28-20 in his debut.

items.h: PANEL: primetime picks
items.t: Side and total on both primetime games, one sentence each.

items.h: Saints at Ravens, 1PM CBS - Baltimore -8.5, O/U 47.5
items.t: Zay Flowers did not practice Wednesday or Thursday with the hamstring and a third straight DNP would make him a bleak bet to play. Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry come off a 31-0 halftime lead on Indianapolis in Week 1.

items.h: Bengals at Texans, 1PM CBS - Houston -3, O/U 46.5
items.t: Joe Burrow has been limited all week with back tightness and says he is playing barring a need for surgery. Ja'Marr Chase had 2 catches for 12 yards in Week 1.

items.h: Texans banged up on both sides for that one
items.t: Nico Collins did not practice Thursday with the hamstring and is called unlikely for Sunday. Jadeveon Clowney (knee) and Ed Ingram (groin) are also dinged.

items.h: Vikings at Bears, 1PM FOX - Chicago -5.5, O/U 49.5
items.t: Kyler Murray is still in concussion protocol with limited participation Wednesday and Thursday; Carson Wentz is the contingency starter. Jordan Mason went to IR with a fractured thumb.

items.h: Rapoport: Murray "has a chance to play Sunday if he continues to progress"
items.t: No Friday designation was posted when we pulled this.

items.h: Commanders at Cowboys, 4:25PM FOX - Dallas -3.5, O/U 50.5
items.t: Highest total on our board. Washington had Frankie Luvu (groin), Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) and Javon Kinlaw (back) all not practicing, with several others limited. Dallas is 0-1 after losing the opener to the Giants.

items.h: Raiders at Chargers, 4:05PM CBS - LAC -6.5 (DraftKings had -7), O/U 43.5
items.t: Ladd McConkey did not practice Wednesday with the rib and is day-to-day. KeAndre Lambert-Smith and Derius Davis are out, and Elijah Molden (hamstring) and Teair Tart (ankle) also missed Wednesday.

segments.title: Quick hits and lock of the week

items.h: Dolphins at 49ers, 4:25PM FOX - SF -13.5, O/U 45.5, the biggest spread of the week
items.t: Miami's implied total of 16.0 is the lowest on the board.

items.h: Tua is doubtful with the oblique and Cooper Rush is in line to start
items.t: Also on the board: Brock Bowers out again for Las Vegas, RJ Harvey questionable with a hamstring in Denver.

items.h: A.J. Brown is on IR in New England with a high ankle sprain
items.t: He will miss at least four games - Steelers, Jaguars, Bills, Raiders - and is eligible to return Week 6 against the Jets.

items.h: PANEL: lock of the week
items.t: One lock from each panelist, side or total, with the reason in a sentence.

hours.title: Hour 2
hours.subtitle: Fantasy Football Hour with John, Frank, and Trent Conner - Week 2 lineups lock Sunday at 1PM

blocks.title: Block 1: What We Learned and Who to Add

items.h: Breakouts: Swift 18-124-3, Coker 8-138-2, Lamar 324 and a rushing TD
items.t: D'Andre Swift ran for three scores. Jalen Coker went 8 for 138 and 2 on nine targets with Bryce Young throwing for 361 and 4. Lamar Jackson threw for 324 in Declan Doyle's new Baltimore scheme.

items.h: Busts: Chase 2-12, Loveland 0 catches, Odunze 2, Pollard 7-35
items.t: Ja'Marr Chase caught 2 of 4 targets for 12 yards. Colston Loveland was shut out on two targets. Tony Pollard managed 7 carries for 35 behind poor quarterback play.

items.h: Role changes that matter: Mason to IR, Lane's wrist, Collins' hamstring
items.t: Jordan Mason's fractured thumb opens the Minnesota backfield for Aaron Jones. Ja'Kobi Lane fractured his wrist reaching for an end zone catch and is out roughly a month. Nico Collins' hamstring elevates Dalton Schultz in Houston.

items.h: RB: Kaelon Black (SF, 15%), Tyler Allgeier (ARI, 42%), Mike Washington Jr. (LV, 39%)
items.t: Black took 14 carries, four more than McCaffrey, and is the priority add - but see the groin note below. Allgeier out-carried Jeremiyah Love 17 to 11.

items.h: WR: Jalen Coker (CAR, 51%), Devaughn Vele (NO, 13%), Caleb Douglas (MIA, 16%), Mack Hollins (NE, 0%)
items.t: Vele caught 7 of 9 for 69 and a goal-line TD. Hollins is the A.J. Brown replacement in New England, deep leagues only.

items.h: TE Michael Mayer (LV, 30%) and QB Bryce Young (CAR, 11%), Carson Wentz (MIN, 0%)
items.t: Mayer caught 6 of 7 targets and Brock Bowers is out again. D/ST adds: 49ers (7%), Packers (16%), Buccaneers (13%), Panthers (1%). No live FAAB percentages were published in the sources we pulled - set your own.

items.h: Kaelon Black was added to the injury report Thursday with a groin
items.t: Limited practice, extent uncertain. Check the Friday designation before you spend FAAB.

segments.title: SEGMENT: Best Starts of the Week

items.h: Must starts: Jordan Love, Aaron Jones, Croskey-Merritt, Golden, Tre Tucker, Fannin
items.t: Love faces a Jets pass rush that pressured on 23.1% in Week 1 and is down a starting safety. Aaron Jones inherits the Minnesota backfield with Mason on IR. Jacory Croskey-Merritt draws a Dallas defense that gave up 27.3 fantasy points to running backs. Harold Fannin Jr. gets Tampa Bay.

items.h: Sits: Trevor Lawrence, Ashton Jeanty, Jeremiyah Love, Jaylen Waddle, Sam LaPorta
items.t: Jeanty's Week 1 receiving TD was the outlier and the game script is a risk. Love had 11 carries to Allgeier's 17 and is still working off the high ankle. Waddle caught 1 of 3 targets in a 28-attempt offense. Too many mouths in Detroit for LaPorta.

items.h: Streamers: QB Wentz and Bryce Young, TE Gesicki and Schultz, D/ST Carolina
items.t: Wentz is 1% rostered after going 12/19 for 133 and 3 in relief, and Chicago gave up 361 and 3 to Bryce Young. Young himself is 4-1 career against Atlanta. Gesicki led Cincinnati with 7 targets and the Bengals have allowed the worst fantasy TE production in the league six seasons running, which makes Schultz the mirror play. Carolina's D/ST faces an Atlanta offense that had 143 passing yards, 2 interceptions and went 2-for-12 on third down.

items.h: PANEL: the Jalen Coker argument
items.t: He shows up as a top waiver add and as a Week 2 sit in two different outlets. Settle it on air.

items.h: Kincaid graduates - he is a start now, not a stash
items.t: Dalton Kincaid caught 5 of 6 targets for a career-high 130 yards in Week 1, including catches of 40 and 35.

items.h: Denzel Boston: 2 catches, 59 yards and a TD, but it came in garbage time
items.t: It was a Browns blowout loss to Jacksonville, so the role is still unproven. Hold as a flier.

items.h: Chris Rodriguez Jr. - drop him, Tuten has the job
items.t: Rodriguez had 6 carries for 23 yards on 23 snaps. Bhayshul Tuten took 15 carries at 4.4 a pop plus a 22-yard catch on 28 snaps. Note the name on last week's list was wrong: it is Chris, not Cody.

items.h: Ja'Kobi Lane - drop in standard leagues
items.t: Fractured wrist, surgery expected, roughly a month. New stash in its place: Rashod Bateman, with Flowers hurting and Lane gone the Baltimore targets have to land somewhere.

items.h: Tank Dell still on IR, designated to return, no date found
items.t: Deep stash only until he is actually practicing.

items.h: Holds: Kaelon Black, Mike Washington Jr., Emmett Johnson
items.t: Black is still the best of the group if the groin clears. Washington is a handcuff only behind Jeanty at 39% rostered. Emmett Johnson had 8 carries for 24 and 2 catches for 44 behind Kenneth Walker's 26 touches - the receiving role is the reason to hold.

items.h: Housekeeping: "Gabe Diggs" does not exist
items.t: The name on last week's list was wrong. It is Stefon Diggs in Washington. We could not retrieve his Week 1 line, so do not put a number on air.

items.h: Highest implied totals: SF 29.5, BAL 28.0, LAR 28.0, CHI 27.5, KC 27.0, DAL 27.0
items.t: Math is half the total plus half the spread. San Francisco at 29.5 off SF -13.5 and a 45.5 total is the play of the week against a Miami team starting Cooper Rush. Baltimore 28.0 off -8.5 and 47.5. Chicago 27.5 off -5.5 and 49.5 - Caleb Williams, Swift and an Odunze bounce-back.

items.h: Shootout to target: Commanders-Cowboys at 50.5, the highest total on the board
items.t: Dallas implies 27.0 and Washington 23.5 off DAL -3.5. Both sides are startable.

items.h: Lowest implied totals: MIA 16.0, LV 18.5, NO 19.5, IND 20.5, NYG 20.5
items.t: Fade the skill players in those games where you have a choice. Miami at 16.0 is the lowest number on the board.

items.t: Anyone rostering Murray needs a Sunday morning backup plan if he does not clear protocol.

items.t: SNF Colts-Chiefs and MNF Giants-Rams reminders, then tease Week 3 waivers and the Brock Bowers return.
